function.name: exec_command
function.description: Workspace inspection/tests/builds; use a listed editing tool for source changes, delete/rename use rm/mv. Call tools directly, not printed placeholders/commentary. No trailing &: leftovers stop on return, yielded processes at session end. Lasting services need detach. function.name: FileRead
function.description: Read text/images/PDFs/notebooks; authorizes edits. Prefer 1-based offset/limit line windows: default 2000 lines, cap 25000 tokens. Line numbers are sparse and display-only. Successful edits need no reread. PDF pages and dense line numbers: system.searchTools select:FileRead.

function.name: apply_patch
function.description:
Use the apply_patch tool to edit files.

Input must obey this patch format:

*** Begin Patch
[one or more file hunks]
*** End Patch

Supported hunks:
- *** Add File: path followed by one or more + lines
- *** Delete File: path
- *** Update File: path, optionally followed by *** Move to: path, then one or more @@ chunks

Patch paths should be workspace-relative unless an absolute path is necessary and inside the allowed workspace roots.

function.name: tool2__system_x2esearchTools
function.description:
Find and load tools that are not in your function list. select (or select:<tool_name> in query) loads a tool's schema by its exact name; query and the filters search the catalog by name, family, source, keyword or profile.

To hand a self-contained task to a helper agent, load spawn_agent with select:spawn_agent; it loads wait_agent, send_message, assign_task, close_agent, list_agents with it.
Deferred tools you can load with select: TodoWrite (a plan for long work), Orient (rank files for a question in a large repository), web_fetch (fetch a web page), WebSearch (search the web), report_agent_job_result (CSV job worker result), AskUserQuestion (multiple-choice question to the user), EnterPlanMode (plan a large change first), ExitPlanMode (present a plan for approval), LSP (definitions and references), NotebookRead (read Jupyter notebooks), request_ledger_transfer (Ledger transfer), ledger_wallet_cli_status (Ledger CLI status), install_ledger_wallet_cli (install the Ledger CLI), VerifyPlanExecution (check progress against a plan), SendUserMessage (progress note to the user).

select.description: Exact tool name or names to load.

function.name: exec_command
function.description: Workspace inspection/tests/builds; use a listed editing tool for source changes, delete/rename use rm/mv. Call tools directly, not printed placeholders/commentary. Batch bounded independent reads. Yielded session_id exposes write_stdin; kill_process stops it. No trailing &: leftovers stop on return, yielded processes at session end. Lasting services need detach. Advanced fields (yield_time_ms, tty, login, shell, detach, max_output_tokens): system.searchTools select:exec_command loads them.

function.name: FileRead
function.description: Read text, images, PDFs or Jupyter notebooks. Default: the first 2000 lines, numbered from 1 (cat -n); for a large file pass offset (1-based) and limit and read only what you need. A read over 25000 tokens fails. PDFs over 10 pages need pages (at most 20 per read). Directories fail: list them with the shell. A whole-file read authorizes edits; Edit and Write fail if their change did not land, so do not re-read to check one.

file_path.description: Workspace/absolute path; not an agent-tree ID.

function.name: Edit
function.description: FileRead first. Replace shortest unique exact old_string with new_string, preserving indentation, omitting unchanged context/display numbers. replace_all replaces every match (default false). Prefer existing files; create only as needed. Emojis only on request.

file_path.description: Workspace/absolute path; not an agent-tree ID.

function.name: MultiEdit
function.description: Several exact replacements in one file, applied in order, each to the result of the one before. Read the file first (FileRead, or exec_command output that printed it whole). Each old_string must be unique when its edit applies unless replace_all is set. The file is written only if every edit succeeds.

file_path.description: Workspace/absolute path; not an agent-tree ID.

old_string.description: Exact text to replace; unique in the file at that point unless replace_all is true.

replace_all.description: Replace every occurrence for this edit (default false).

function.name: Write
function.description: Create/replace complete files; existing files require FileRead first. Use Edit for partial changes. Documentation/emojis only on request.

file_path.description: Workspace/absolute path; not an agent-tree ID.

function.name: Glob
function.description: Find file paths by glob, newest modification first. Skip gitignored/build/vendor files unless includeIgnored=true.

function.name: Grep
function.description: Search with packaged ripgrep, not shell grep/rg; escape literal braces. output_mode: files_with_matches (default paths), content (lines), count. Context/line numbers apply to content. multiline matches across lines with dot-all. Skip ignored/build/vendor files unless includeIgnored=true. Missing ripgrep: agenc doctor, reinstall same version; no fallback. Other fields (-n, -A, -B, -C, type, head_limit, offset, multiline, includeIgnored) are accepted; system.searchTools select:Grep loads their schema.

function.name: Skill
function.description: Run a skill listed in the system reminders within this conversation; when one matches the request, call it before responding. Skill names only: MCP tools are called through their own function after system.searchTools loads them.
